City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
la puente City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
DECEMBER 10, 2013
7:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Klinakis, Lewis, Argudo, Holloway, and House
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF A STAFF REPORT AND A RESOLUTION TO SANTA CLAUS
Presentation of Staff Report to Santa Claus
Presentation of Resolution to Santa Claus - Attachment A
PRESENTATION OF A CERTIFICATE OF APPRECIATION TO DENISE BATES AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY
PRESENTATION OF MILITARY BANNER CERTIFICATES: EZEKIEL COVARRUBIAS AND WILLIE GALINDO
Military Banner - Covarrubias.
Military Banner - Galindo
PRESENTATION FROM COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES LIBRARY TO BOOKMARK CONTEST WINNERS
PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES OF RECOGNITION TO SHERIFF'S DEPUTIES RUBEN VALENCIA AND LORENZO BRIGHT

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council members provide a report on any Boards/Commission/Committee meetings, listed below, that they have attended or that have occurred.
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY - None.
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN URGENCY ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE ADOPTING BY REFERENCE, PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 50022.2, TITLE 26 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY BUILDING CODE, INCORPORATING BY REFERENCE THE CALIFORNIA BUILDING CODE 2013 EDITION; TITLE 28 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY PLUMBING CODE INCORPORATING BY REFERENCE THE CALIFORNIA PLUMBING CODE 2013 EDITION; TITLE 27 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY ELECTRICAL CODE, INCORPORATING BY REFERENCE THE CALIFORNIA ELECTRICAL CODE 2013 EDITION; TITLE 29 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY MECHANICAL CODE, INCORPORATING BY REFERENCE THE CALIFORNIA MECHANICAL CODE 2013 EDITION; TITLE 30 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY RESIDENTIAL CODE, INCORPORATING BY REFERENCE THE CALIFORNIA RESIDENTIAL CODE 2013 EDITION; TITLE 31 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY GREEN BUILDING STANDARDS CODE, INCORPORATING BY REFERENCE THE CALIFORNIA GREEN BUILDING CODE 2013 EDITION, AND ADOPTING LOCAL AMENDMENTS THERETO, AND MAKING FINDINGS FOR SAME, AND DECLARING THE URGENCY THEREOF
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) Open the Public Hearing and take oral and written testimony; 2) Waive the reading of the Urgency Ordinance and read by title only; 3) Introduce and adopt the Urgency Ordinance; and 4) Adopt the Notice of Exemption.
B-1 Building Code- Staff Report
B-1 Building Code Urgency Ordinance - Attachment A
B-1 Building Code Non Urgency Ordinance - Attachment B
B-1 Notice of Exemption - Building Codes - Attachment C
B-1 Exhibit 1 Building Code
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE ADOPTING BY REFERENCE, PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 50022.2, TITLE 26 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY BUILDING CODE, INCORPORATING BY REFERENCE THE CALIFORNIA BUILDING CODE 2013 EDITION; TITLE 28 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY PLUMBING CODE INCORPORATING BY REFERENCE THE CALIFORNIA PLUMBING CODE 2013 EDITION; TITLE 27 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY ELECTRICAL CODE, INCORPORATING BY REFERENCE THE CALIFORNIA ELECTRICAL CODE 2013 EDITION; TITLE 29 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY MECHANICAL CODE, INCORPORATING BY REFERENCE THE CALIFORNIA MECHANICAL CODE 2013 EDITION; TITLE 30 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY RESIDENTIAL CODE, INCORPORATING BY REFERENCE THE CALIFORNIA RESIDENTIAL CODE 2013 EDITION; TITLE 31 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY GREEN BUILDING STANDARDS CODE, INCORPORATING BY REFERENCE THE CALIFORNIA GREEN BUILDING CODE 2013 EDITION, AND ADOPTING LOCAL AMENDMENTS THERETO, AND MAKING FINDINGS FOR SAME
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) Waive the reading of the Ordinance and read by title only; 2) Introduce the Urgency Ordinance; and 3) Adopt the Notice of Exemption; and 4) Set a Public Hearing on the Ordinance for January 14, 2014.
D.
CITY COUNCIL - SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/ Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NOS. 1354 AND 18
It is recommended that the City Council and the Successor Agency adopt the Resolutions approving Warrant Register Nos. 1354 and 18.
D-1 WR # 1354
D-1 SA WR # 18
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF THE APPOINTMENT OF THE CITY MANAGER TO THE CIVIC RECREATIONAL INDUSTRIAL AUTHORITY
It is recommended that the City Council appoint the incoming City Manager, David Carmany, to the Civic-Recreational Industrial Authority (CRIA) Board effective January 1, 2014.
D-2 Staff_Report_Appoint David Carmany as LP CRIA Board Rep
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING A REQUEST FOR A FEE WAIVER AND USE OF LA PUENTE PARK FOR THE AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY'S RELAY FOR LIFE OF LA PUENTE EVENT
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the attached resolution approving a request for a fee waiver in the amount of $4,290.00, for the American Cancer Society California Division Inc.'s 2014 Relay for Life of La Puente event.
D-3 Staff Report - Relay for Life
D-3 Attachment (A) Resolution Relay for Life
D-3 Attachment (B) Letter of Intent for the Relay for Life
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF THE ESTABLISHMENT OF AN AUDIT COMMITTEE AND DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING A POLICY TO REVIEW THE CITY'S FINANCIAL POLICIES AND PROCEDURES, IN RESPONSE TO THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CIVIL GRAND JURY'S 2012-2013 REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) refrain from establishing an audit committee until mandated to do so by the State of California; and (2) direct staff to develop a Council policy requiring the annual review of the City's accounting policies and procedures, and an update to those policies and procedures no less than once every three years.
D-4 Staff Report on Grand Jury Recommendations - Audit Comm & Review of Acctg Policies
D-4 Attachment A - City Respone to Grand Jury Questionnaire
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING CITY COUNCIL POLICY CC - 7.1, SURPLUS PROPERTY
It is recommended that the City Council adopt a resolution approving City Council Policy CC - 7.1, Surplus Policy.
D-5 Surplus Policy Agenda Report
D-5 Attachment A - Surplus Property Policy Resolution
D-5 Attachment B - La Puente Surplus List
D-5 Exhibit A - Surplus Property Policy
D-6
SECOND READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 13-925 RESCINDING SECTION 10.74.060(f) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE PERTAINING TO NON-COMMERCIAL SIGNS AND ADDING SECTION 10.74.061 TO CHAPTER 10.74 OF THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE TO INCLUDE COMPREHENSIVE REGULATIONS FOR NON-COMMERCIAL SIGNS IN THE CITY - MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENT 137
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Ordinance No.13-925 an Ordinance of the City of La Puente, California rescinding Section 10.74.060(f) of the La Puente Municipal Code Pertaining to Non-Commercial Signs and adding Section 10.74.061 to Chapter 10.74 of the City's Municipal Code to Include Comprehensive Regulations for Non-commercial Signs in the City.
D-6 CC Staff Report - Second Reading of Non-Commercial Signs Ord
D-6 Non Commercial Sign Ordinance - Attachment A
D-7
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE AND LOCAL 721, SERVICE EMPLOYEES INTERNATIONAL UNION (SEIU)
Adopt the Resolution approving the Memorandum of Understanding.
D-7 Staff_Report_Appoint Consideration of Adopting Reso Approv MOU re SEIU (12-4-13)
D-7 Attachment A Reso SEIU MOU
D-7 Attachment B Proposed MOU
ITEMS D-7 AND F-1 WERE REMOVED FROM THE AGENDA AND NOT DISCUSSED
RECESS INTO CLOSED SESSION
F.
CLOSED SESSION:
F-1
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE 54957.6(a) TO CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS. AGENCY DESIGNATED REPRESENTATIVES: MARTIN LOMELI, INTERIM CITY MANAGER; JAMES CASSO, CITY ATTORNEY.
RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION
REPORT OF OUT CLOSED SESSION
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
